description: General-document golden evaluation dataset covering technical infrastructure, organizational security policy, and product specifications without SEBI regulatory assumptions.

queries.question: What is the minimum password length requirement and character complexity for Acme user accounts?
key_facts_to_preserve: minimum 16 characters in length
uppercase, lowercase, numeric, and special symbol characters

queries.question: How are service accounts required to authenticate, and are static passwords permitted?
key_facts_to_preserve: strictly prohibited from using static passwords
short-lived OAuth2 mTLS certificates expiring every 12 hours

queries.question: What happens after consecutive failed login trials at Acme?
key_facts_to_preserve: exceeding 5 consecutive trials
automated 30-minute account lockout
notify the Security Operations Center (SOC)

queries.question: How frequently must cryptographic service keys and TLS certificates be rotated?
key_facts_to_preserve: at least every 90 days without exception

queries.question: Within what timeframe must all Active Directory and cloud IAM permissions be revoked upon employee termination?
key_facts_to_preserve: automated access deprovisioning triggers immediately
within 60 seconds

queries.question: When do third-party contractor credentials expire, and who can authorize an extension?
key_facts_to_preserve: expire automatically after 30 days
extension approved in writing by Chief Information Security Officer (CISO)

queries.question: What database engine, version, and replication mechanism does Acme use for production workloads?
key_facts_to_preserve: PostgreSQL 16
streaming replication
asynchronous hot standby failover

queries.question: What are the recovery point objective and recovery time objective for critical tier-1 transactional workloads?
key_facts_to_preserve: recovery point objective (RPO) is strictly 5 minutes
recovery time objective (RTO) is 15 minutes

queries.question: What is the recovery point objective for non-critical analytical databases?
key_facts_to_preserve: non-critical analytical databases operate with an RPO of 24 hours

queries.question: How often are production database snapshots captured and for how many days are they retained?
key_facts_to_preserve: every 6 hours
retained for 30 calendar days in encrypted object storage

queries.question: How long are staging and development environment snapshots retained, and do they get automated failover?
key_facts_to_preserve: retained for only 7 calendar days
do not receive automated failover

queries.question: In a regional failure, how quickly does automatic DNS failover trigger, and where does traffic route?
key_facts_to_preserve: triggers within 120 seconds
routing traffic to eu-west hot standby

queries.question: What is the standard ingestion rate limit and burst allowance for the Acme Enterprise Data Mesh?
key_facts_to_preserve: standard ingestion rate limit is 10000 events per second per tenant
burst allowance up to 15000 events per second for a maximum duration of 60 seconds

queries.question: What is the maximum allowed payload size for Data Mesh ingestion, and what HTTP error is returned if exceeded?
key_facts_to_preserve: payload sizes exceeding 2 megabytes are rejected
HTTP 413 Payload Too Large

queries.question: What happens to telemetry events that arrive with missing tenant headers in the Data Mesh?
key_facts_to_preserve: routed directly to the dead-letter queue (DLQ)
for manual inspection within 24 hours

queries.question: What are the hot caching and cold archive retention durations for standard Data Mesh telemetry?
key_facts_to_preserve: hot memory-cached storage for 7 days
cold parquet archives for 365 days

queries.question: Do database backup snapshots adhere to the Data Mesh 365-day cold archive retention policy?
key_facts_to_preserve: database snapshots are managed independently of the telemetry mesh
snapshots adhere to 30-day storage limits, not 365 days
